public_private_divide.traditional_framing: Domestic violence as private family matter
public_private_divide.problem: Obscures state responsibility for prevention protection investigation and remedy
public_private_divide.international_legal_reframing: May constitute discrimination failure of due diligence violation of life security equality and remedy
public_private_divide.practice_question: Did state institutions treat repeated violence as public legal risk

public_private_divide.traditional_framing: Sexual violence in war as incidental
public_private_divide.problem: Minimizes organized violence command responsibility terror and persecution
public_private_divide.international_legal_reframing: May constitute war crime crime against humanity genocide torture or persecution
public_private_divide.practice_question: Was the violence connected to conflict command structures group targeting or civilian attack

public_private_divide.traditional_framing: Reproductive control as moral or domestic issue
public_private_divide.problem: Obscures bodily autonomy health equality privacy and dignity
public_private_divide.international_legal_reframing: May implicate health privacy non-discrimination bodily integrity and freedom from ill-treatment
public_private_divide.practice_question: Did law or policy coerce or deny reproductive autonomy

public_private_divide.problem: Hides gendered coercion harassment trafficking migration vulnerability and economic dependency
public_private_divide.international_legal_reframing: May implicate labor rights anti-trafficking law equality and violence harassment standards
public_private_divide.practice_question: Did employment or migration status create coercive vulnerability

public_private_divide.problem: Risks normalizing violence or making it immune from scrutiny
public_private_divide.international_legal_reframing: International law rejects cultural justification for violence discrimination and coercion
public_private_divide.practice_question: Is culture being used to understand context or excuse abuse

gender_based_violence_frameworks.core_question: Did the state respect protect and fulfill rights without discrimination
gender_based_violence_frameworks.legal_significance: Creates duties of prevention protection investigation punishment remedy and structural reform
gender_based_violence_frameworks.example_context: Domestic violence harmful practices reproductive coercion policing failures

gender_based_violence_frameworks.core_question: Is violence connected to discrimination stereotypes or unequal institutions
gender_based_violence_frameworks.legal_significance: Treats gender-based violence as discrimination and requires substantive equality
gender_based_violence_frameworks.example_context: State tolerance of violence unequal family law access to justice barriers

gender_based_violence_frameworks.core_question: Does a regional treaty or court provide a stronger procedural path
gender_based_violence_frameworks.legal_significance: May provide binding judgments specific violence instruments and regional due diligence doctrine
gender_based_violence_frameworks.example_context: Belém do Pará Istanbul Convention Maputo Protocol

gender_based_violence_frameworks.core_question: Did the harm occur in armed conflict or affect protected persons
gender_based_violence_frameworks.legal_significance: Regulates violence detention dignity sexual violence and protection during conflict
gender_based_violence_frameworks.example_context: Conflict-related sexual violence displacement detention checkpoints

gender_based_violence_frameworks.core_question: Does the conduct satisfy war crime crime against humanity genocide persecution or command responsibility elements
gender_based_violence_frameworks.legal_significance: Creates individual criminal responsibility for atrocity crimes
gender_based_violence_frameworks.example_context: Sexual slavery forced pregnancy rape persecution forced marriage

gender_based_violence_frameworks.core_question: Does feared harm amount to persecution connected to a protected ground where state protection is unavailable
gender_based_violence_frameworks.example_context: Forced marriage trafficking domestic violence anti-LGBTQ persecution

gender_based_violence_frameworks.core_question: Was exploitation produced through force coercion deception abuse of vulnerability or abuse of power
gender_based_violence_frameworks.legal_significance: Requires identification protection non-punishment investigation and remedy
gender_based_violence_frameworks.example_context: Sexual exploitation forced labor domestic servitude forced marriage

gender_based_violence_frameworks.core_question: Did violence harassment or exploitation occur in the world of work
gender_based_violence_frameworks.legal_significance: Connects gendered harm to workplace safety equality and labor regulation
gender_based_violence_frameworks.example_context: Harassment migrant domestic work supply chains informal labor

due_diligence_workflow.description: State takes reasonable steps to reduce known risks
due_diligence_workflow.legal_question: Did the state address foreseeable patterns of gender-based violence
due_diligence_workflow.example_evidence: Laws training shelters public education risk assessment data

due_diligence_workflow.description: Authorities respond to specific threats and vulnerable situations
due_diligence_workflow.legal_question: Did officials act once they knew or should have known of risk
due_diligence_workflow.example_evidence: Reports threats protection orders police calls prior assaults

due_diligence_workflow.description: State investigates promptly seriously impartially and without stereotypes
due_diligence_workflow.legal_question: Was the investigation gender-sensitive and evidence-based
due_diligence_workflow.example_evidence: Case files forensic records witness statements interview protocols

due_diligence_workflow.description: Perpetrators and complicit officials face appropriate consequences
due_diligence_workflow.legal_question: Did impunity or discriminatory enforcement sustain violence
due_diligence_workflow.example_evidence: Charging decisions prosecutions discipline corruption records

due_diligence_workflow.description: Survivors receive effective accessible and non-discriminatory remedies
due_diligence_workflow.legal_question: Did remedies address safety repair health and future risk
due_diligence_workflow.example_evidence: Compensation medical care psychosocial support housing legal aid

due_diligence_workflow.description: State addresses systemic conditions that reproduce violence
due_diligence_workflow.legal_question: Did the state reform institutions rather than only individual cases
due_diligence_workflow.example_evidence: Policy reform budget data collection training monitoring

procedural_risks.description: Decision-makers rely on stereotypes about behavior sexuality family or credibility
procedural_risks.legal_consequence: May undermine equality fair procedure and effective remedy
procedural_risks.lawyer_facing_question: Are credibility findings based on myths about ideal victims

procedural_risks.description: Survivors face retaliation stigma deportation detention or economic loss
procedural_risks.legal_consequence: May make remedies ineffective in practice
procedural_risks.lawyer_facing_question: Can the person report without worsening danger

procedural_risks.description: Institutions demand evidence unavailable in private violence conflict or displacement
procedural_risks.legal_consequence: May deny access to justice through discriminatory evidentiary standards
procedural_risks.lawyer_facing_question: Is the proof standard realistic for the harm alleged

procedural_risks.description: Interviews or hearings reproduce harm through hostile questioning or lack of safeguards
procedural_risks.legal_consequence: May impair participation and accuracy of evidence

procedural_risks.description: System treats prosecution as the only meaningful remedy
procedural_risks.legal_consequence: May ignore prevention housing health income immigration and structural reform
procedural_risks.lawyer_facing_question: What remedy would actually change the survivor's options

procedural_risks.description: Law recognizes only extreme conflict or atrocity violence as international
procedural_risks.legal_consequence: May obscure everyday domestic workplace reproductive and institutional violence
procedural_risks.lawyer_facing_question: Is harm being minimized because it appears ordinary or private
